newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: BHP needs more changes to copper - Prescott.
newsitem.headline: BHP needs more changes to copper - Prescott.

text.p: The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd's managing director John Prescott said on Tuesday that the group would make further changes to its copper division under its overall strategy of improving each division's short-term performance outlook.

"In copper, I think it is well understood what we have to do. There will need to be a further rationalisation of our copper operations. But at the same time there are a number of growth projects that will be developed," Prescott told a media briefing here.
BHP called the briefing to discuss its announcement earlier on Tuesday that it would phase out steelmaking at its Newcastle plant by the end of 1999.
The company also said it planned to close its Geelong rod mill and Sydney wire mill in 1999.
Based on a review of domestic and international steel operations, BHP said it would disband its international steel division and restructure BHP Steel around four divisions.
